title: Primal finite element scheme of the Hodge-Laplace problem
summary: In this paper, we construct nonconforming finite element spaces $\boldsymbol{V}^{\mathbf{d}\cap\mathring{\boldsymbolδ}}_hΛ^k$ for the approximation of $HΛ^k\cap H^*_0Λ^k$ on simplicial meshes, for $n\ge 2$ and $1\le k\le n-1$, by enforcing adjoint continuity against piecewise Whitney spaces rather than trace matching. It holds, with $\mathbf{d}^k_h$ and $\boldsymbolδ_{k,h}$ denoting respectively the piecewise action of differential and codifferential operators, and $\boldsymbol{\mathfrak{H}}_hΛ^k$ being the discrete harmonic forms in the FEEC sense, that…
